substrate_boundary: resident registrar SQLite + resident server certificate loader + host TLS/network runtime
state_class: resident authority state + public issuance state + server binding state
persistence_class: SQLite/WAL + filesystem certificate state + append-only/unique receipts
address_space: DOMAIN_ROOT/DNS_ROOT/TLS_ROOT/SERVER_ROOT plus DNS names and host binding paths
virtualisation_type: semantic identity and authority indirection over replaceable carrier/substrate adapters

interfaces.name: DNS01_PUBLISH
interfaces.contract: publish and read back exact _acme-challenge TXT under owned zone

interfaces.name: DNS01_CLEANUP
interfaces.contract: remove exact challenge and read back absence

interfaces.name: PUBLIC_CA_ISSUE
interfaces.contract: SAN-bound CSR to verified certificate material

interfaces.name: SERVER_TLS_INSTALL
interfaces.contract: atomic install restart and live fingerprint readback

proof_conditions: exact deployment SHA dependency snapshot accepted by GitHub
DNS-01 TXT mutation and cleanup read back through registrar authority
public CA returned key/certificate/chain material validates
live SERVER_ROOT presents installed certificate fingerprint
external hostname and system trust verification succeeds
rollback_requirements: snapshot existing server certificate/key before install
reverse partial server mutations in reverse order
read back restored server certificate state
invalid_claims: certificate file creation proves SERVER_ROOT consumption
local CA test issuance proves public CA trust
dependency snapshot generation without GitHub acceptance proves dependency admission
